{{Quote|I like to stick with safe ''name-brand'' food.''"<br />&laquo;''But this "name-brand" you speak of is not ''safe'' at all! It is produced entirely by ''child labor''. Wookiee children on the neighboring planet of ''Kwookrrr''&mdash;who are not yet old enough for their rites of passage&mdash;work their hands ''furless'' in horrifying factories! It is a modern-day slavery!''&raquo;|quoteend=0|"[[Lurdo]]" and a [[Unidentified Wookiee (xachibik broth)|Wookiee]], on [[Crumps™ crunchy wog cluster]]s|<ref name="WTCM" />}}
'''Kwookrrr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were used for labor in [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and [[Farm/Legends|farms]]. It had previously been a Wookiee colony world.
